findings.detail: Real Worker map page cache metadata was top-level; core now bridges it and rejects conflicting duplicates. Real HTTP E2E included in final gate.
Selective job compaction must not collect newer denial while older allow remains pinned. Bounded old-first/head protection and replay test added.
Failed or in-flight nofollow is met at both base selection and ingestion; map uses actual committed follow policy. Same two-case harness passes frozen build.
Core and Worker share 1601 lower date bound; two Worker regressions added.
304 does not widen authority/range/budget; retained complete links may be reconstructed at the current job depth. No behavior change.

authoring_corrections: Initial native fixtures used pre-schema12 column count/future-version expectations; corrected fixtures without weakening assertions.
Initial real HTTP test terms URL was invalid and a report field name was wrong; fixed test setup/expectation and retained failures.
Independent evaluation probes corrected sources to source_outcomes; no product edit.
Independent publication probe stopped requiring stable snapshot ID when restrictive publication changes representation identity; body/evidence/policy checks retained.
limits: No full work package or slice signoff; source availability and genuine human quality remain unverified.
Independent agents are cross-role code/test reviewers, not human qrels assessors.

Final integrated execution and exact published SHA CI remain separate evidence.
